newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas closes higher but afternoon session thin.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas closes higher but afternoon session thin.

text.p: The IPE natural gas futures contract saw only two deals done on Wednesday afternoon, with 50 lots traded to add to the 155 done in the morning session.
The afternoon session was quiet except for two trades of 25 lots each in October and November. The simultaneous trades were done at the same price as trades in each month in the morning session.

A futures broker speculated that some of the trades done in the morning were strip or spread deals involving a small number of companies, and there was speculation that the afternoon trades may have been part of a similar arrangement.
Prices in most months had risen during reasonably active trade on Wednesday morning, before the market settled down in the afternoon session and activity faded away.
